name: ur10e_io (PLACEHOLDER, set for your cell)
note: PLACEHOLDER: set for your cell. Every port, level, scaling and dwell is a slot to fill from your cell wiring and your spindle drive manual. None comes from a real cell. A null value means not set: that output posts as a comment. A spindle driven by a controller plug-in function replaces the start, stop and speed entries with call actions (see docs/CELL_IO.md).

ready_inputs.note: set for your cell: a cell-ready input (enclosure, drive ready)

fault_input.note: set for your cell: drive fault input and its no-fault level

start.note: set for your cell: spindle run output

speed.note: set for your cell: speed reference volts per rev/min and the analog range of the output

ready.note: set for your cell: at-speed input, or null

spindle.note: dwell_s: wait after start, set for your cell; max_rpm: the drive limit, set for your cell

start.note: set for your cell: bow saw wire motor run output

on.note: set for your cell: water valve output
set for your cell: air blow valve output

tool_change.message: Put tool {tool} in the spindle, then press Continue
tool_change.note: manual change by default; a tool changer needs mode changer, its actions and pockets, set for your cell
